notes:
talk2me now needs macOS 15 or later. Its voice models on your Mac cannot load on older macOS, so an older Mac is told up front instead of downloading a voice that cannot run. Every Mac with Apple silicon can update to macOS 15 for free.
Deleting a cleanup model that runs on your Mac's GPU no longer freezes the window while a cleanup finishes.
If talk2me cannot start, a window now says so and where the log is, instead of the app vanishing.
